1088-progress.name: Braelyn Firehand
1088-progress.text: When my master bade me to the peak of Stonetalon, I expected that all I would need was to lay waste to the night elves that crawled the sacred ruins of our ancient temple of Azshara, their touch despoiling its sanctity... but Ordanus had slipped my grasp.
1088-progress.title: Ordanus

5881-progress.name: Grish Longrunner
5881-progress.text: You have news from Maggran Earthbinder?
5881-progress.title: Calling in the Reserves

6283-progress.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6283-progress.text:
Bloodfury Ripper is a nasty creature! You will have success finding her along the western hill line in the Charred Vale.

The bloodfuries will be helpless with out... surely we can vanquish them forever!
6283-progress.title: Bloodfury Bloodline

6381-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6381-progress.text:
These seeds you plant are strong, resisting corruption, and making a foothold for other life. They will grow and grow, first preventing corruption and healing the scarred land, and then one day, restoring Stonetalon to a lush forest, once again.

Have you planted all of the Gaea seeds?
6381-progress.title: New Life

6441-progress.name: Pixel
6441-progress.text: I hope you can be quick about getting those horns, $N. I'm heading back to Ratchet soon!
6441-progress.title: Satyr Horns

65604-accept.name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
65604-accept.text:
Yes... I see. I feel the residual emotions bound within these threads. Love is woven into its stitches. The incubus will not be able to resist.

Take this to the summoning circle in Neeru's tent, $N. Summon forth a malevolent incubus, then show it your mastery. Do not expect it to be subdued quietly. Ready your magic and prepare yourself for a fight. Underestimating a demon has been many a $c's final mistake.

When you have defeated it, return the cloth to me. I will let Magar know what you found.
65604-accept.title: The Binding

65604-complete.name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
65604-complete.text:
Hah! Victorious, as expected!

The incubus is subdued, and it will be my pleasure to teach you to summon the demon. You strength is growing, and I have no doubt that this is a mere stepping stone to even greater powers.

I will return the scarf to Magar. I have known that orc for many years, and never did I think he would care for someone the way he cared for Krilge.

It is a reminder of what separates us from the demons. We wield their darkness, but they will never wield us.
65604-complete.title: The Binding

65604-progress.name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
65604-progress.text:
The sayaad are dominators of minds and torturers of souls. Their visage brings the heart joy, leaving you defenseless when they rend your flesh with whip and claw.

Do not entertain the incubus' charms, $N. Slay it quickly and let it be done.
65604-progress.title: The Binding

65610-complete.name: Gan'rul Bloodeye
65610-complete.text: What is it you have there, $N? A scarf made of... Mooncloth? You best not be seeking to romance me.
65610-complete.title: Wish You Were Here

6581-progress.name: Pixel
6581-progress.text:
Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.

..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!

What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.

So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
6581-progress.title: Warsong Saw Blades

97003-progress.name: Gur'ak
97003-progress.text:
It took the strength of six skilled fighters to defeat one of these creatures, and it still managed to fell four of us before we could put it down.

If these monstrous beasts were to appear in greater numbers, the damage that the quilboar could inflict upon the land could be catastrophic.
97003-progress.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener
